treatment_summary: The plan addresses ESRD secondary to diabetic nephropathy with hypertension, CAD, anemia and CKD‑MBD. An ACE‑I (ramipril) and statin (atorvastatin) are started per NG203 for renoprotection and CV risk reduction. ESA (darbepoetin alfa) and IV iron (ferric carboxymaltose) treat CKD‑related anemia after confirming iron deficiency. Sevelamer carbonate and alfacalcidol manage hyperphosphataemia and secondary hyperparathyroidism per NG107. Amlodipine is added if BP remains above target. All drugs are dose‑adjusted for eGFR ≈ 5 mL/min, contraindicated agents are avoided, and monitoring (electrolytes, Hb, iron studies, bone profile, BP) is scheduled per NICE recommendations.
